$comment: Manifest entries for `illustrate`, read by src/lib/manifest-parts.ts (and by `manifest --json` when present). Names are resolved from the files they point to, so the list cannot drift.

commands.name: illustrate
commands.summary: A dot illustration from a built-in subject or any picture, through the brand's dot shader. Writes SVG (every dot a real circle, grouped as field, hollow and filled) and PNG. Same input, settings and seed give the same bytes.
commands.unknownName: exits 1 and names the nearest choices
